detail.title: Intex IFPVM-6502/IFPVM-6507 - Ultra HD 4K Interactive Flat Panel Display (65 Inches)
detail.overview: Intex 65" Interactive Flat Panel The Intex IFPVM-6502/IFPVM-6507 65" Interactive Flat Panel Display combines innovation with functionality, perfect for classrooms or offices. Its 4K UHD IPS display offers vivid visuals, while the 20-point multi-touch system ensures smooth interactions. Powered by Android 14, it supports apps for enhanced productivity. Features like a 48MP AI camera, 8-microphone array, and dual 20W speakers make video conferencing seamless. Durable with anti-glare glass and antibacterial coating, it’s built to last. With multiple connectivity options, including HDMI and USB Type-C, and optional OPS expansion, this display is versatile and ready to elevate collaboration and engagement.
features: 65" Ultra HD 4K Display for stunning visuals
IPS Panel with DLED Backlight for vibrant clarity
48 MP AI Camera & 8 Microphone Array for video conferencing
Dual 20W Built-In Speakers for clear audio

Connectivity: HDMI, USB Type-C, LAN, RS232, TF Card Slot
